English: Wooden Bow Stand
A makeshift rack of wood for drying staves and storing bows, assembled in the open steppe to provide the bare minimum for archery practice and repairs.
Bow Carver Hut
A simple hide-and-wood shelter where an artisan shapes bows and repairs damaged weapons for the clans warriors.
Arrowmakers Tent
A large felt tent where skilled fletchers craft arrows in bulk, improving the supply and quality of missile weaponry for the horde.
Composite Bow Pavilion
A semi-permanent gathering of crafters and apprentices, specializing in the lamination and assembly of advanced composite bows for Magyar warriors.
Fletchers Room
A reinforced wooden structure, equipped for fine arrow-making and bowstring preparation, producing deadly ammunition and boosting clan unity.
Fine Bow Hall
A prominent wooden hall adorned with the clans banners, where only the finest bows are crafted and stored for elite warriors, inspiring all nearby.
Bowyers Chamber
A fortified chamber where master bowyers secretly teach advanced techniques, drastically improving bow quality and manpower efficiency.
Guild Pavilion
A sprawling pavilion that serves as the headquarters of the bowyers guild, attracting renowned craftsmen and fostering a culture of martial innovation.
Champions Armory
A legendary armory where only the greatest champions are equipped with masterwork bows and gear, dramatically increasing the hordes ranged superiority.
Magyar Bowyer Guild
The proud and ancient guild of Magyar bowyers, a permanent institution famed for its legendary craftsmen and its power to shape the very destiny of the horde.
